title: Prop 15.141: size-12 Seidel partner; all 8 H_+ types Max+-free; p=7 residual Max+-free closed; bi-tight path p=5,7
settlement_note: No soft-close for general p. Explicit size-12 flip set T on affine non-4AP base closes last p=7 type Max+-free. Free c_j recovers δ²≤room at p=7. Bi-tight empty at p=5,7 via residual Max+-free + mult≥d−1. N_ED4_SUF still OPEN for all p≥5. L OPEN.
